answers.reason: Accepted: p4-s2 is 安らかさ, not 安息, so keeping {t:rest} here would collapse the distinction the house keeps for p17.

data.revised_english: The day had ended. The grief and suffering of that day were about to flow into the peace of night. And they smiled in silence, fixing their eyes on everything in the child.
data.say: Accepted the peace/rest fix for p4-s2 to preserve the yasurakasa/ansoku distinction.
